screen.autototem.title: Auto Totem Settings
screen.autototem.hint: Drag the HUD boxes with the mouse to move them
screen.autototem.toggle.tooltip: Turns the whole mod on or off. The key can be changed in Controls.
screen.autototem.delay.tooltip: How long to wait before the totem is moved to your offhand. 0 means as soon as possible, 20 ticks is one second.
screen.autototem.health_toggle.tooltip:
OFF: the totem goes to your offhand right away.
ON: it only goes there when your health drops to the threshold, and goes back to its slot once you have healed.
screen.autototem.health_value.tooltip: Equip the totem when your health is at or below this many hearts.
screen.autototem.first_hit.tooltip: Also move the totem to your offhand as soon as you take any damage. It goes back once you are fully healed.
screen.autototem.notification_toggle.too: Shows a message and plays the sound when a totem is used.
screen.autototem.sound_import.tooltip: Pick a WAV, AIFF or AU file from your computer. It is copied to config/autototem. While a custom sound is active, the normal totem sound is muted.
screen.autototem.sound_waiting: Pick a file in the dialog window...
screen.autototem.sound_err_format: Unsupported file. Use WAV, AIFF or AU.
screen.autototem.sound_err_decode: Could not read this audio file.
screen.autototem.sound_err_long: Sound is too long (30 seconds max).
screen.autototem.sound_err_dialog: No file dialog here. Put a WAV named custom_sound.wav into config/autototem and reopen this screen.
